title: Remove rename view WebView flat exports
summary: Removed the remaining renameView direct flat window exports and routed app-level rename controls through window.mediaPipelineRenameView. Refreshed the WebView public contract baseline, global export inventory, and generated summaries.
reason: Continue the namespace-first WebView cleanup by reducing transitional flat exports in the touched Rename domain without changing backend-owned rename mutation behavior.
behavior_before: Rename controls could still depend on direct window-level helpers such as refreshRenamePreview, checkApplicableRenameRows, and stageRenameBulkEdit exported from renameView.js.
behavior_after: Rename controls call the existing mediaPipelineRenameView namespace, while renameView.js keeps the functions internal or namespace-owned and no longer emits those 18 direct flat compatibility exports.
rollback_plan: Restore the removed window.<rename helper> assignments in apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/renameView.js, revert app.js event handlers to the prior direct helper calls, regenerate the WebView public contract/inventory, refresh summaries, and rerun the same WebView static/API/browser checks.
notes:
Removed remaining renameView flat exports and updated namespace wiring plus inventory/contract coverage.
Refreshed generated summaries for the changed WebView contract, inventory, assets, and tests.
